title: Repository Root Cause Trace QnA
summary: Trace a multi-file repository behavior bug and explain the root cause with concrete evidence and a fix outline.
fairness_notes: This is a read-mostly task. No code changes are required.
The grader is deterministic and rubric-based.
anti_cheat_notes: Rubric items require specific files, fields, and control-flow explanations.
A vague summary without concrete evidence will only receive partial credit.
